title: Prosecution ends witness presentation vs Rep. Jojo Ang in conflict of interest case
summary: The Office of the Ombudsman on Wednesday rest its case against suspended Uswag Ilonggo Rep. Jojo Ang in two graft cases over his alleged conflict of interest in infrastructure projects.
